title: Remove diagnostics tail WebView flat exports
summary: Removed the seven duplicate diagnosticsTailView direct flat window exports, made diagnosticsView resolve tail helpers from mediaPipelineDiagnosticsTailView first, and refreshed the WebView public contract baseline, global export inventory, and generated summaries.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup by reducing transitional flat exports in the Diagnostics tail child module while preserving diagnosticsView compatibility globals used by existing consumers.
behavior_before: diagnosticsTailView.js directly assigned selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget, selectedDiagnosticsTailMaxBytes, setDiagnosticsTailTarget, setDiagnosticsTailStatus, setDiagnosticsTailBusy, renderDiagnosticsTail, and requestDiagnosticsTail onto window in addition to its namespace object.
behavior_after: diagnosticsTailView.js exposes those helpers through mediaPipelineDiagnosticsTailView only; diagnosticsView.js consumes that namespace first and continues publishing the existing compatibility globals after full script load.
manual_validation: python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke -q - passed; fixture emitted broken ActiveJobs record warnings but tests passed
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - passed after packet field update
rollback_plan: Restore the seven window.<diagnostics tail helper> assignments in diagnosticsTailView.js, switch diagnosticsView.js helper resolution back to the prior flat-first order if needed, regenerate the WebView public contract/inventory, refresh summaries, and rerun the same diagnostics static/browser checks.
notes:
Removed duplicate diagnostics tail child-module flat exports while keeping diagnosticsView compatibility aliases.
Updated WebView public contract and global export inventory for diagnostics tail child export removal.
Refreshed generated summaries for diagnostics tail export cleanup.
